security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: asset: http://asset.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Capture ideas in a flash. Plain Markdown notes.
bundle.longDescription: Flashjot pops up a small box on a global shortcut so you can write an idea down and get back to work. A notebook window keeps your pages and an Inbox of quick notes. Everything is stored as plain Markdown files.
